structure: Single high school course. Header u1 gives 'Grade/Course: Global Studies / ACCN: CGW2400'. Pages are series of small tables: Strand (Global Studies) + Standard heading: 'Standard N: ...' (standards 1-5 cycle twice); per benchmark a table with Topic, benchmark text and code (Benchmark SS.G.S.n.m), Sample Performance (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Rubric sentences sometimes split across page breaks.
